  > 1. The Brief's noise curve P_flip(f) ≈ Φ(−z√(1−f)) is the wrong conditional: for random deletion of a fraction f of the *observed* sample the flip probability is Φ(−z√((1−f)/f)) (RMSE 0.010 against simulation vs 0.070, biased). So f_q = z²/(z²+c_q²), c_q=|Φ⁻¹(q)|; for q=16% f_q < 0.8 only for z < ~2.
  > 2. Q = k*·gmax/gap is not ≥ 1 under exact refit (deletion: Q ≈ 0.97 on correctly specified BT; flip: 1.08 sparse to 1.3 dense graphs). It is read against its same-graph parametric-bootstrap null as the Brief intends; the inequality F ≥ z holds in the linear regime only.
  > No action needed beyond the wording of the Brief.
